HYPOTHESIS.finding: The question - do two Mahler-measure subsets share a spacing profile beyond what scale explains - is coherent and answerable: the normalized statistic is non-degenerate on real data, varies between pairs (-0.69 to +0.47), and a label-permutation null distinguishes some pairs from chance (T3). It was never fairly tested, so it is neither confirmed nor falsified. Reader-divergence point: a Cleric may prefer NOT_EXAMINED on the ground that no fair instrument ever touched the hypothesis; the Necromancer records VALID as 'well-posed', not 'true'.

DESIGN.finding: The design compared two subsets of DIFFERENT sizes by rank correlation with no pairing relation between elements, hard-coding 'truncate the larger to its n smallest values' - a choice T5 shows decides the verdict (two of three PROMOTED pairs 0% stable under random size-n subsampling); it thresholded corr_norm at 0.30 with no null, no chance floor and no seed replication (T4: PROMOTED rate under independence up to 0.33); and its settle policy excluded UNVERIFIED so non-settling pairs consumed the run (replay: 256/286 rows on three pairs). The intended 'before vs after normalization' contrast was designed around a statistic (corr_raw) that the design itself made constant by sorting both sides.

IMPLEMENTATION.finding: corr_raw = _spearman(sorted(a_vals)[:n], sorted(b_vals)[:n]) is Spearman of two monotone sequences and equals 1 identically (T1: 1000 independent random draws, max dev 2.2e-16; T2: 1.0 on DB order, shuffled and reversed for all 9 real pairs). The loader also returns values already sorted by M, so even a non-sorting implementation of the same design would have produced 1.0 (T2 non-sorted DB-index pairing). Consequence: pollux_no_correlation_observed is unreachable (rescan Q3) and the four-way classifier is a one-dimensional threshold on corr_norm.

CONFIGURATION.finding: The daemon imports on this tree with its dependencies (prometheus_math mahler DB, stygian_priority_queue); all 9 configured pairs load with n >= 10 on both sides; constants (SETTLE_THRESHOLD 5, CORR_SIGNIFICANT 0.30, CORR_FLIPPED_DELTA 0.20) are as the 05-25 patch set them. The 9-pair menu and thresholds are design choices, judged under DESIGN. Historical machine config (cadence, paths) is not recoverable and not needed for the verdicts above.

EXECUTION.finding: Pollux executed as written for the whole swarm window: 286 ticks, every one success=true, 2026-05-24 03:08 to 2026-05-30 11:55 local, 286 distinct cycle_id, 9 distinct summaries - the exact count a deterministic 9-pair menu predicts - and the three summaries preserved in the second channel equal today's rescan to 4 dp. It stopped in the fleet halt (15 agents within 45 minutes), not on its own. Caveat: the second channel was written by the daemon itself in the same tick as the ledger row (single mechanism); it confirms that the process ran and what it computed, not that the lost ledger matched P69's census.

INSTRUMENTATION.finding: The instrument's first leg (corr_raw) cannot observe the data: its value is fixed at 1.0 by construction for any two inputs (T1, T2). The 'scale artifact' the instrument was built to detect (raw correlation that vanishes after normalization) is therefore undetectable and 'attenuates' / 'sign_flips' / 'survives' are labels for corr_norm intervals, not for a before/after contrast. The kill_ledger rows record corr_raw=1.0 faithfully, which is why the 06-24 reader could see it and the 06-10 reader did not look.

MEASUREMENT.finding: PROMOTED / REJECTED were emitted as verdicts with no null, no chance floor and no replication: under pure independence at the daemon's sample sizes the PROMOTED rate reaches 0.33 (T4); against a label-permutation null one PROMOTED pair fails (deg14 p=0.093) and the two that pass (salem p=0.014, small_large p=0.001) flip to REJECTED in 100% of random size-n subsamples (T5). The measured quantity was 'which corr_norm interval did the n-smallest truncation land in', not 'does a spacing coincidence survive normalization'.

INTERPRETATION.finding: Four readings on record mis-state what the rows meant: 06-10 'real signal' (no null; raw leg not inspected); 06-22/23 REVIVE 'Real signal' (inherited); 06-24 'ZERO Learner references' (false; sources.py landed 06-10); 08-21 P69 'mechanically explains the Hecate MI null' and 'Hecate consumed' (vocabulary exclusion makes bit content irrelevant) while omitting the tautology already on record. The 06-24 tautology reading was correct and was left as an unexecuted assertion for 79 days; the 08-12 prescription for the executing script was never run until this pass.

ECOSYSTEM.finding: Every consumer seam was broken independently of Pollux's own faults: Stygian's survivor path was a stub for the entire run (E9 of the 05-25 plan, never built), Hecate's >=2-generator rule excluded Pollux's vocabulary by construction, Erebos used pair names only, and the Ergon Learner - the one consumer that trained on the rows - overwrote every verdict with gold=False. The run ended in the 05-30 fleet halt with the stub still in place. A correct Pollux would have died here too; this Pollux did not get that far.

fair_test.scope: The whole run 2026-05-24..05-30 and every reading of it since; no window is clean because the instrument and design faults are in the code, not in the environment.
fair_test.finding: Pollux never tested its premise. The before/after-normalization contrast it was built on had a constant 'before' leg (T1/T2), the 'after' leg was thresholded without a null (T4) on a truncation that decides the answer (T5), and no consumer could have validated a PROMOTED pair (Stygian stub). The 39 PROMOTED and 86 REJECTED verdicts are not evidence for or against spacing coincidences in Mahler subsets. This is epistemic: the hypothesis remains open, and a fair test is specifiable (matched-marginal or two-sample spacing test with a published chance floor, seed replication, verdicts carrying p-values).

representation_hints: A scanner that compares two unpaired samples must name its pairing relation or use a two-sample test; 'sort both and correlate' is not a comparison, it is the identity.
Every verdict field needs a payload-reading null and a published chance floor beside it, in the same row (T4's 0.33 floor would have been visible at design time).
A verdict that changes under an arbitrary truncation choice is a verdict about the truncation; sensitivity to that choice (T5) should be a gate, not an afterthought.
Cross-generator information seams (Hecate) should publish their admission rule where generators can see it; Pollux was built to feed a statistic that could not admit its vocabulary.

disposition.rationale: Chosen over MEASUREMENT_FAILURE because the deepest load-bearing INVALID is DESIGN: with the tautological raw leg repaired, the same design (no pairing relation, verdict-deciding truncation, thresholds without a null, UNVERIFIED-excluding settle) would still emit verdicts with a chance floor up to 0.33 and 0% truncation stability (T4, T5); the measurement faults are downstream of that. Chosen over TRUE_CORPSE because the premise was never tested at all - the record contains no observation of a Mahler spacing coincidence or its absence.
